title: ASML 微影機系統工程
summary: 拆解光源、光學、精密平台、真空與量測的共同設計，深入理解 DUV 透鏡與 EUV 反射鏡為何不同。以公開原理建立原創示意模型。
summaryEn: Explore the co-design of source, optics, precision stages, vacuum and metrology, including why DUV lenses and EUV mirrors differ. Build an original schematic from public principles.
scope: 公開原理的分層工程教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務，並非原廠配方、施工圖或操作許可。
scopeEn: A layered course in public engineering principles. Steps are verifiable learning tasks, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, or operating authorization.

steps.titleEn: Decompose resolution
steps.objective: 完成「拆分解析度指標」的概念模型與工程檢核。
steps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for decompose resolution.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: Rayleigh 形式 CD = k1 λ / NA 連結波長、數值孔徑與製程因子。
knowledge.textEn: The Rayleigh form CD = k1 λ / NA connects wavelength, numerical aperture and process factor.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 固定兩個參數，觀察第三個參數對概念解析度的影響。
knowledge.textEn: Hold two parameters fixed and vary the third in the conceptual resolution model.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「ASML 微影機系統工程」的「拆分解析度指標」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「光學工作台：焦點失蹤」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Decompose resolution” in “ASML Lithography Systems Engineering”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Optical Bench: Missing Focus” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 哪個敘述最直接說明「拆分解析度指標」的核心原理？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains decompose resolution?
options: Rayleigh 形式 CD = k1 λ / NA 連結波長、數值孔徑與製程因子。
印得小與印得準是不同能力，套刻關注不同層的相對位置。
光學、平台、熱漂移與量測誤差會共同影響成像，相關誤差不能任意平方和。
optionsEn: The Rayleigh form CD = k1 λ / NA connects wavelength, numerical aperture and process factor.
Printing small and printing accurately are different capabilities; overlay concerns interlayer position.
Optics, stage, thermal drift and metrology errors combine; correlated errors cannot be blindly combined by root-sum-square.
quiz.explanation: Rayleigh 形式 CD = k1 λ / NA 連結波長、數值孔徑與製程因子。
quiz.explanationEn: The Rayleigh form CD = k1 λ / NA connects wavelength, numerical aperture and process factor.
